plate_comment: Boot initializer of cm848_runEndOfLineTestSequence (called from cm848_applicationMain): clears end_of_line_test_seconds_since_engine_start and its pass divider, shows a failed result again (MIL override 3) when end_of_line_test_malfunction_indicator_lamp_power_down_state_flag_cal is 1, sets end_of_line_test_output_number to 80 (no output), end_of_line_test_step to 0 and end_of_line_output_test_state to 1, and idles the intake air heater reading delay timers (0xffff) (was cm848_initialization_group21_state_cont)

Step 0 of cm848_runEndOfLineTestSequence. Through EEPROM byte writes it clears the in-plant flag bytes (end_of_line_test_settings_cal.test_flags_1 to _5) except the pending / not-passed bits of the tests, and clears those bits for each test that end_of_line_test_enable_flags disables (bit 0 the intake air heater test - test_flags_5 bits 0-1, bit 5 the alternator test - test_flags_4 bit 0, bit 1 the misfire test - test_flags_5 bits 4-5); it also sets bytes 4-5 of eeprom_shadow_header.calibration_block1 to 0 / 0x19. It returns the first pending step: 1 the output tests (test_flags_2 bit 3 or test_flags_5 bit 0), 3 the alternator test (test_flags_3 bit 5), 5 the misfire test (test_flags_5 bit 4), 6 the final result (final_test_results_1 bit 3), else 7 (done) (was engine_protection_timerStateMachine_init)

Step 2 of cm848_runEndOfLineTestSequence: the intake air heater test verdict. Both voltage drops (end_of_line_test_intake_air_heater_1_voltage_drop / _2_voltage_drop) above end_of_line_test_intake_air_heater_minimum_delta_voltage_threshold pass it (test_flags_5 bit 1 cleared, MIL override 2); otherwise the MIL override goes to 3 and end_of_line_test_malfunction_indicator_lamp_power_down_state_flag_cal to 1. It clears test_flags_5 bit 0 (the test pending) and returns step 3 (was diag_camSync_deviation_check)

Step 3 of cm848_runEndOfLineTestSequence: the alternator test (e2m 164A EOL_EVR_*) while test_flags_3 bit 5 is set (else step 4). With the engine running it turns the MIL override on once (end_of_line_alternator_test_started_flag). When end_of_line_test_time_since_engine_start passes end_of_line_test_alternator_test_delay it snapshots the battery voltage and sets end_of_line_alternator_test_field_cut_flag (cm848_applyAlternatorFieldDuty then drives alternator_field_end_of_line_test_duty, 0); after end_of_line_test_alternator_test_time it releases the field. The verdict takes the present voltage minus the snapshot in 16 bits, so any fall passes (test_flags_4 bit 0 cleared, MIL override 2) and no fall sets end_of_line_test_malfunction_indicator_lamp_power_down_state_flag_cal; test_flags_3 bit 5 is cleared and it returns step 4 (was engine_coldStart_batteryVoltage_monitor)

Step 6 of cm848_runEndOfLineTestSequence: shows the plant tester's final verdict on the MIL. While end_of_line_test_settings_cal.test_results_1 bit 3 is set it waits; bit 2 must then read the same on two passes (end_of_line_test_step_sub_state 3 / 4). Clear (pass) sets the MIL override to 2, set (fail) to 3 with end_of_line_test_malfunction_indicator_lamp_power_down_state_flag_cal; both return step 7 (done). A failed result from an earlier step (the power-down flag) is shown again (override 3) on every pass (was engine_protection_timerBitCheck_dispatch)

Called each pass of cm848_runEndOfLineOutputTestStep while the intake air heater test runs (test_flags_5 bit 0 and end_of_line_test_enable_flags bit 0): counts down each heater's reading delay timer (0xffff = idle). When one reaches 0, its voltage word (the battery voltage stored when the heater switched on) becomes that value minus the present battery voltage - the drop the heater causes (was sensor_battery_voltage_decrement)

Returns 0 when recent_fault_dtc_codes_cal holds no DTC, or only the DTC of the given fault (ROM 0x5985a slot -> obd_dtc_code_table), else 1. cm848_runEndOfLineOutputTestStep calls it with fault 256, which has no DTC slot (slot 170, past the table), so there it means 'a DTC is stored' (was fault_event_check_conflict)

Requests a logical output for the end-of-line output tests at the given priority (5): keeps the output's present priority in end_of_line_test_output_previous_priority, the output in end_of_line_test_output_number and the priority in end_of_line_test_output_priority, then calls cm848_setLogicalOutputRequest (was fault_event_queue_set_active)

Releases a logical output of the end-of-line output tests: zeroes its priority while it still holds end_of_line_test_output_priority, then calls cm848_clearLogicalOutputRequest with the output and end_of_line_test_output_previous_priority (was fault_event_queue_clear_active)

Step 1 of cm848_runEndOfLineTestSequence: the output tests (e2m 164A; engine stopped). When the engine is not stopped, or neither the intake air heater test (test_flags_5 bit 0 with end_of_line_test_enable_flags bit 0) nor the output tests (test_flags_2 bits 3 and 4) are pending, it releases the outputs and the actuator tests and returns step 3. After a two-pass start delay end_of_line_output_test_state runs: 1 starts the fuel control / alternator field / cooling fan actuator tests (enable bits 6 / 5 / 7) and turns the MIL override on; 2 runs the lift pump (output 53, enable bit 3 - with the bit clear the state never moves on) for end_of_line_test_lift_pump_on_time and passes it without P0629 / P0628 (test_flags_2 bits 5 and 7 cleared); 3 runs the wait-to-start lamp (output 4, bit 2) and the A/C clutch relay (output 38, bit 4) for end_of_line_test_relay_on_time; 4-7 run intake air heaters 1 and 2 (outputs 43 / 44) one at a time, each storing the battery voltage for cm848_measureEndOfLineIntakeAirHeaterVoltageDrops; 7 passes the output tests when no DTC is stored (test_flags_2 bit 4 cleared), clears bit 3 and returns step 2 for the heater verdict (step 3 without the heater test). Each output is on for its on time and off for end_of_line_test_relay_off_time (end_of_line_output_test_timer / end_of_line_output_test_output_on_flag), requested at priority 5 through cm848_setEndOfLineTestOutputRequest / cm848_clearEndOfLineTestOutputRequest (was engine_coldStart_protection_stateMachine)
Boot initializer of cm848_checkRadiatorFanSpeedRationality (P0483): clears radiator_fan_speed_out_of_range_count (was cm848_initialization_group25_state)

Main loop: counts down the SCI command 0x25 (37) test timeouts that cm848_sciCommand37Callback sets and ends each test at 0 - the alternator field actuator test (alternator_field_actuator_test_active_flag), the lift pump test (output 53 at priority 5; also ended once the engine leaves ENGINE_STATE_STOPPED), the cylinder contribution test (DRB 25-25; also ended when cylinder_contribution_test_status is 2), the high pressure safety valve test (DRB 25-26; also ended when high_pressure_safety_valve_test_state is 2) and the 48RE governor pressure / converter clutch / overdrive solenoid tests (transmission_shift_strategy_flags.service_test_request_flags bits 0 / 1 / 2, outputs 18 / 17) (was protectionVoltageTimeoutControl)

Boot initializer (cm848_applicationMain): clears the alternator field, lift pump, cylinder contribution and high pressure safety valve test timeouts of SCI command 0x25 (was initProtectionVoltageTimer)
